# Genuine ShieldMissileV1 compatibility saves

These seven unchanged official exports were generated on 2026-09-30 by the
verified original production source `c4d8c34c19b5c92eca789f292f99632a0107d861`. Test-only diagnostic capture
commit `2b839d7fc7c8caa8574304ea6f99020ed491e849` is a direct child of that source and changes no
production, dependency, content or UI code. All three original scenarios finished
normally, including their later continuations and cleanup. An earlier interrupted
run and raw database candidates are not the origin of these files.

The separate direct-child baseline `05b43bddade5c400e4efa12fadec1d798d5fc0c6` changes only its standalone
test file. It compiled and completed all eight tests, unfiltered and serial, with
zero failures/ignored tests and no interruption. Its recorded wall time was
10899.172 seconds. Both root and independent completion
audits verified source/tree, full logs, exact compiled and preserved executables,
all original evidence hashes and every immutable export. The environment was
Windows GNU Rust 1.98.1, jobs1, incremental disabled and default test stack.

Both diagnostic branches are published solely to preserve reproducible provenance;
their capture hooks must never merge into production. Exact source and baseline
commands, original log hashes, binary hashes and portable per-file evidence are
recorded in `flow4-c4d8-provenance.json`. Accompanying normal-completion display
logs replace only the absolute workspace prefix; both original and published
hashes are recorded explicitly. Original raw logs remain preserved externally.
To reproduce, check out the appropriate diagnostic commit separately and use the
recorded environment: `DMD_FLOW4_CAPTURE_DIR` names a fresh external output
directory for all three capture commands, or the immutable seven-file corpus for
the baseline. Use `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1`, `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0`, unset
`RUST_MIN_STACK` and profile/compiler/runner overrides, and the recorded Windows
GNU target flag. Capture output is create-new; never rerun over historical files.

The seven boundaries include a selected ordinary-hit Shield; selected missile
Shield before payment; three accepted faces; all six faces before impact; first
and fifth genuine concentration children; and the first raw save of a committed
ordinary spell. No pending state, physical face, original command, receipt,
snapshot or binding was manufactured or rewritten. The fifth-child export retains
five completed impacts and one owed automatic singleton after that child.

The receiving `legacy_shield_missile_v1_replay.rs` is the exact original verified
suite with only its module comment and fixture loader changed. It independently
restores actual file databases, cold-reopens, compares material continuations,
checks exact accepted retries and changed-body no-write refusals, and retries every
original binding. Missing files fail; there is no skip or regeneration fallback.
Git attributes preserve the raw bytes across platforms.

This establishes original-source provenance and baseline behavior only. The
receiving flow5 head, its canonical/CI continuation tests, dependency integration
and packaged release play still require separate verification. Neither the fixture
import nor a parent result completes that acceptance or Gate4.
